sealed_statement.R1: On every D-profile K_k(F), a currently live dynamic forced-color query R1(u,c) is true exactly when c belongs to the exact palette A(u).
sealed_statement.R2: On every currently live nonedge uv of K_k(F), R2(u,v,c) is true exactly when c belongs to A(u) intersect A(v).
sealed_statement.behavioral_collapse: For profiles with the same threshold m=max(F), all R1/R2 truth values on common live coordinates coincide. Differences among other bits of F survive only as live-domain/reconstruction information.
sealed_statement.carrier: The entire future reachable K_k closure has an exact polynomial carrier storing per-original-vertex ACTIVE/FIXED/DELETED status, fixed colors and independent receipt pointers.
sealed_statement.common_palette: Every L/R vertex is adjacent to fixed s4=4, so every active L/R list is always contained in common palette {1,2,3}. If z is unfixed it may be assigned 4; if z is fixed in {1,2,3}, its color is deleted from R lists.
sealed_statement.backend: Therefore every future extension/R1/R2 query reduces exactly to constructive P7-free List-3 on the active induced L/R chain graph plus independent receipts.
sealed_statement.lifecycle: Carrier storage, query, B2B1 canonical update and reconstruction are polynomial in k and do not enumerate the 2^(k-1) explicit D-profiles.

U1_firewall: Exponentially many exact/domain-aware classes do not imply exponential representation size when an explicit polynomial bitvector carrier supports all exact queries and updates.
explicit_nonclaims: No polynomial carrier theorem for arbitrary connected Q_ALL.
